notes: Mirrors the two existing candidate mappings in cpp-tck.parameter-handle-name-lookup. The C++ TCK now covers valid Get Parameter Handle/Get Parameter Name round-trips for two configured pairs in the p0 FOM; the Java TCK still covers one pair. The C++ invalid-name and invalid-handle assertions are supplemental API-contract checks, not additional Lab requirement mappings, and no broader service behavior is claimed.

requirements.statement: Get Parameter Handle returns a valid handle for the configured interaction-class parameter name.
Get Parameter Name returns the exact name associated with the supplied valid interaction-class and parameter handles.
